services.name: Counselling
services.whatFor: Talking through stress, low mood, anxiety, relationships, grief, or anything that is weighing on you. You do not need a diagnosis or a 'big enough' problem.
services.firstSession: A relaxed 50-minute conversation with a counsellor about what is going on and what might help. Nothing is decided for you.
services.whoWillKnow: Only the counsellors of this service. Not your lecturers, not your parents, not other students.

services.name: Health clinic
services.whatFor: Everyday physical health: vaccinations and flu shots, feeling unwell, minor injuries, medical certificates, and general health questions.
services.firstSession: A 15 to 20 minute visit with a campus nurse. Bring your student ID.
services.whoWillKnow: Only the nurses of the health clinic.

services.name: Physiotherapy
services.whatFor: Aches, sports injuries, back and neck pain from study, and recovery after an injury.
services.firstSession: A 30-minute assessment of the problem area and a first set of exercises.
services.whoWillKnow: Only the physiotherapists of this service.

services.name: Wellbeing advising
services.whatFor: Practical help with sleep, study-life balance, money worries, settling in, and finding the right support on or off campus.
services.firstSession: A 30-minute chat with a wellbeing officer to map out what would make things easier.
services.whoWillKnow: Only the wellbeing officers of this service.
